# muxt check reports a link to another package whose argument has the wrong type.

muxt generate
! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/m/blog": [{}]
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /admin Dashboard()").Parse(`<a href="{{.Path.Blog.GetArticle "x"}}">x</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
